# Soumya Chauhan Permanent Makeup Studio

> Permanent makeup (PMU) by Soumya Chauhan in Purnea, Bihar, India. The studio is opening soon in Bhatta Bazar, Chitrawani Road, Purnea 854301. Services: eyebrow microblading, powder and ombre brows, lip blush, permanent eyeliner, BB glow, scalp micropigmentation, plus skin, hair and nail treatments. Pre-booking is open on WhatsApp.

Contact: +91 72095 58552 (phone and WhatsApp). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/schauhanpmu/

- [Services](https://scpmu-purnea.vercel.app/services.html): All permanent makeup and beauty services.
- [Gallery](https://scpmu-purnea.vercel.app/gallery.html): Before and after photos and videos.
- [Pricing](https://scpmu-purnea.vercel.app/pricing.html): How quotes work. Every treatment is priced after a free consultation.
- [FAQ](https://scpmu-purnea.vercel.app/faq.html): Safety, pain, healing, preparation and aftercare.
- [Contact and booking](https://scpmu-purnea.vercel.app/contact.html): Booking form, phone, WhatsApp and map.
